author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the 'Completely in IMAX' Featurette for The Odyssey, the latest mythological action retelling of Homer's tale from the mind of Christopher Nolan. Check out the behind-the-scenes look of the process of filming the first movie entirely in IMAX. The Odyssey is in theaters on July 17.

Christopher Nolan’s next film, The Odyssey, is a mythic action epic shot across the world using brand-new IMAX® film technology. The film brings Homer’s foundational saga to IMAX® film screens for the first time and opens in theaters everywhere on July 17, 2026. 

The Odyssey stars Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson and Lupita Nyong’o, with Zendaya and Charlize Theron.

The Odyssey is produced by Emma Thomas and Christopher Nolan for their company, Syncopy. The executive producer is Thomas Hayslip.
title: The Odyssey - Official 'Completely in IMAX' Behind the Scenes Clip (2026)

author: IGN
description: As the video game world digests Sony’s shock decision to kill video game discs on PlayStation consoles starting January 2028, analysts believe it sends a strong signal about the PS6 — including when it will come out. Plus, Microsoft is sending notifications out to Xbox Game Pass members reminding them that Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 won’t be in the subscription service this year. So if they want to play the game at launch, they’ll have to buy it. Daemon has all that and more on your Daily Fix!
title: Shock Sony Announcement Sheds New Light on PS6, Analyst Says - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Join members of the development team at Funcom for a deep dive into the updates that shaped Dune: Awakening in the year after the open-world survival game's launch. A recap of PC updates includes changes to PvP, endgame progression rework, specialization and augments, and more which will also be available on the console versions. The team also gives a peek at what's coming in future updates, as well as the new update available later this year on September 22 alongside the console release on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X/S. Updates coming to Dune: Awakening include single-player mode with scalable difficulty, a conclusion of the story arc for Book 1: Awakening, and more. Dune: Awakening is available now on PC, and it is coming to PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox on September 22, 2026.

Dune: Awakening is an open-world survival game with immersive adventure and RPG gameplay. Explore, build, craft, and unravel a cinematic Dune story alone or with friends as you rise from survival to
title: Dune: Awakening - Official Deep Dive: Past Year Recap and September Preview Video

description:
Here's a look at gameplay from The Alters: Last Variable in this trailer for the upcoming expansion to the sci-fi survival adventure game. The Alters: Last Variable will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on July 13, 2026.

In The Alters: Last Variable expansion, Jan Scientist awakens from cryosleep with a singular purpose: to solve the mystery of the Oasis. Across years-long planetary cycles, Jan must Terraform barren sectors into habitable zones, extract and refine exotic substances, and unlock research tiers to push the boundaries of scientific understanding. Yet discovery comes at a cost - the planet responds with escalating threats: earthquakes, radiation surges, and the passage of time itself. Field Labs offer the given Alters refuge to conduct research during surface expeditions, but ageing without cryosleep's protection remains inevitable.

title: The Alters: Last Variable - Official Gameplay Trailer

In this snippet from Beyond Episode 951, Nick sits down with Angel Beltran Palau, Lead Producer and David Jaumandreu, Game Director of Denshattack!. Denshattack! The game definitely takes inspiration from SEGA era dreamcast games such as Jet Set Radio, Crazy Taxi, and the Tony Hawk Series. 
Check out the full episode of Beyond, IGN's PlayStation podcast here! - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oKaJ7UndDtM&t=1673s

This week's interview is hosted by Nick Maillet.
